questions.q: On 16 July 2025, India achieved a major milestone by successfully destroying two aerial high-speed unmanned targets at high altitude in Ladakh using the upgraded variant of the Akash Weapon System for the Indian Army called ______.
questions.explain: The upgraded variant of the Akash Weapon System, known as 'Akash Prime', successfully intercepted and destroyed two high-speed unmanned aerial targets in Ladakh in July 2025.
